description:

NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

**Key Areas of Responsibility**

* Design and maintain cybersecurity architecture using risk criteria and Defence-in-Depth principles
* Perform Threat modelling and Risk analysis for strategic technology initiatives
* Serve as a software security resource for assigned projects
* Identify and develop new architecture standards for secure cloud and AI adoption
* Quantify business needs to achieve value outcomes and share best practices

description:

* + Partner with infrastructure, desktop engineering, cloud, application, security, global Brand, and technology teams to implement Cortex capabilities and resolve complex platform and agent issues.
* + Work directly with Palo Alto Networks and other technology partners to troubleshoot complex issues, validate product capabilities, coordinate upgrades, and drive technical issues toward resolution.

* + Support change-management processes and ensure platform changes are appropriately tested, documented, communicated, implemented, and validated.
* + Identify and implement improvements to platform reliability, automation, configuration, monitoring, and operational processes, and participate in on-call and after-hours engineering support as required.
  

  

BTECH - 6-10 Years of relevant experience in managing End Point security with **Cortex XDR and/or Cortex XSIAM** is strongly preferred.

title: Security Engineer III - IN
description:
**Rackspace Security (Public Cloud)**

**SIEM Engineer L3 (Sentinel + Elastic)**

**About Rackspace Cyber Defence**

Rackspace Cyber Defence is our next generation cyber defence and security operations capability that builds on 20+ years of securing customer environments to deliver proactive, risk-based, threat-informed and intelligence driven security services.

**Our purpose** is to enable our customers to defend against the evolving threat landscape across on-premises, private cloud, public cloud and multi-cloud workloads.

**Our goal** is to go beyond traditional security controls to deliver cloud-native, DevOps-centric and fully integrated 24x7x365 cyber defence capabilities that deliver a **proactive** , **threat-informed** , **risk-based** , **intelligence-driven** approach to detecting and responding to threats.

**Our mission** is to help our customers:

* Proactively detect and respond to cyber-attacks – 24x7x365.
* Defend against new and emerging risks that impact their business.
* Reduce their attack surface across private cloud, hybrid cloud, public cloud, and multi-cloud environments.
* Reduce their exposure to risks that impact their identity and brand.
* Develop operational resilience.
Maintain compliance with legal, regulatory and compliance obligations.  

  

**Key Accountabilities**

* Assist with customer onboarding by configuring and integrating data feeds into SIEM platforms with primary focus on Microsoft Sentinel and Elastic Security. Good to have experience in Splunk, IBM QRadar, and Google SecOps (Chronicle)
* Ensure the Customer’s operational and production environment remains healthy and secure at all the times.
* Onboard and integrate on-premises and cloud resources into Elastic SIEM, MS Sentinel, ensuring reliable security log ingestion, parsing, and monitoring.
* Develop custom dashboards and reporting templates.
* Develop complex to customer specific use cases.
* Advance platform administration, ideally through a DevOps-centric approach.
* Solution recommendation for issues.
* Co-ordinate with vendor for issue resolution.
* Basic and Intermediate Playbook and workflow enhancement.
* Maintain close working relationships with relevant teams and individual key stakeholders, such as incident response and disaster recovery teams as well as information security etc.
* Develop the custom parsers for the Incident and alert enrichment.
* Problem specific playbook and workflow creation and enhancements

· Required to work flexible timings.

**Skills & Experience**

* Should have relevant experience of 8+ years.
* Proven experience in administering, configuring, and supporting Microsoft Sentinel and Elastic Security (Elastic SIEM) in large-scale cloud and enterprise environments, with the ability to independently manage SIEM operations, onboarding, integrations, and troubleshooting.
* Elastic SIEM / Elastic Security (mandatory): Strong hands-on expertise in Elasticsearch, Kibana, Elastic Agent, Fleet, Logstash, data ingestion, integration management, parsing, ECS normalization, detection rules, alerts, dashboards, and incident investigation.
* Cloud Security Monitoring: Experience integrating and monitoring security logs from Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, GCP and AWS environments within Elastic Security.
* Microsoft Security Integration: Experience onboarding and analyzing security telemetry from Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and Microsoft Defender for Office 365.
* Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR): Experience integrating and monitoring endpoint security events from solutions such as CrowdStrike and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Network Security Integration: Experience onboarding and troubleshooting security logs from firewalls and network security platforms, including Palo Alto, Fortinet, Juniper, and Cisco.
* Web Application Firewall (WAF): Experience integrating and monitoring WAF logs from Cloudflare, Akamai, and Azure WAF.
* Email Security: Experience integrating and analyzing email security telemetry from Proofpoint, Mimecast, and Microsoft Defender for Office 365.
* Data Loss Prevention (DLP): Experience integrating and monitoring DLP events from Microsoft Purview, McAfee, and Symantec solutions.
* AWS Security Monitoring: Experience onboarding and analyzing AWS security logs and findings from AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, Macie, AWS Config, and CloudTrail.
* Experience integration GCP logs into SIEM tools.
* SIEM Administration & Troubleshooting: Ability to independently troubleshoot ingestion failures, parsing issues, integration errors, agent health, data gaps, and performance problems, and to optimize data ingestion, retention, and storage.

* Knowledge of security standards (good practice) such as NIST, ISO27001, CIS (Center for Internet Security), OWASP and Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) etc.
* Knowledge of scripting and coding with languages such as Terraform, python, javascript, golang, bash and/or powershell.
Knowledge of DevOps practices such as CI/CD, Azure DevOps, CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Ansible and/or Jenkins.

Holds one, or more, of the following certificates (or equivalent): -

* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)
* Elastic Certified SIEM Analyst / Elastic Certified Engineer
* CompTIA Security+ / CySA+ or equivalent security certification is desirable.

o GIAC Security Operations Certified (GSOC)

o Certified Information Security Systems Professional (CISSP)

* Self-motivated, proactive, and customer-focused professional.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple incidents in a fast-paced operational environment.

* Partner cross-functionally with internal stakeholders such as Finance, Product, GBSC, etc., to develop analytical toolkit that drives efficiency on issue detection for key initiatives and focuses across corporate and regions
